name: GCB
recent: Guan Chong Berhad 公布截至2026年9月30日止季度业绩，净利按年大幅增长至 RM277.65 million，并宣布第四次中期股息每股 2.0 sen。同期，公司完成多笔 C 凭单转换新股上市，大股东 Guan Chong Resources 多次申报股权变动。
notable: 公布截至2026年9月30日止季度业绩，净利 RM277.65 million，按年增长超过六倍。
宣布第四次中期单层股息每股 2.0 sen，除息日 2026年12月1日，派发日 2026年12月18日。
完成多笔 C 凭单转换，新股分别于2026年9月7日及9月21日上市。
risks: 大股东 Guan Chong Resources Sdn. Bhd. 在2026年9月至11月期间多次申报股权变动。
董事总经理 Tay Hoe Lian 在闭门期內表示有意进行证券交易。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日止季度，营收为 RM1,803.67 million，按季下降31.2%，按年下降53.6%；净利为 RM253.02 million，按季增长104.8%，按年增长424.9%；净利率为14.0%，高于上一季度的4.7%。

recent_en: Guan Chong Berhad reported a sharp year-on-year rise in net profit to RM277.65 million for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 and declared a fourth interim dividend of 2.0 sen per share. During the period, the company completed several listings of new shares from Warrant C conversions, while substantial shareholder Guan Chong Resources filed multiple changes in its interest.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 with net profit of RM277.65 million, up more than sixfold year-on-year.
Declared a fourth interim single-tier dividend of 2.0 sen per share, with ex-date on 1 December 2026 and payment date on 18 December 2026.
Completed several Warrant C conversions, with new shares listed on 7 September 2026 and 21 September 2026.
risks_en: Substantial shareholder Guan Chong Resources Sdn. Bhd. filed multiple changes in its interest between September and November 2026.
Managing Director Tay Hoe Lian indicated an intention to deal in securities during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM1,803.67 million, down 31.2% QoQ and 53.6% YoY; net profit was RM253.02 million, up 104.8% QoQ and 424.9% YoY; net margin was 14.0%, higher than 4.7% in the previous quarter.
